text.p: Roja fish cannery, quoted on the Riga bourse's secondary list, had a 1996 net profit of 68,819 lats on net turnover of 4.66 million lats, the stock exchange said on Tuesday.
The company's production costs came to 4.47 million lats and administration costs were 39,036 lats, the bourse said in a statement.
Roja's balance sheet showed a minus of 11,737 lats of operating income and 45,271 lats of interest payable.
The company had 16,248 lats of extraordinary charges which pushed its extraordinary profit and loss before taxes into minus 14,844 lats.
Roja's balance sheet total in 1996 was 2.11 million lats and its tangible assets were 1.04 million lats.
It also had debtors worth 653,538 lats and 402,546 lats worth of stocks.
The company's equity capital came to 525,945 lats and it had creditors worth 1.58 million lats.
